properties.title: The Sovereign Villa — Waterfront Luxury Mansion
properties.address: Plot 18, Zone A, Banana Island, Ikoyi, Lagos
properties.description: An architectural masterpiece offering uninterrupted water views across Lagos Lagoon. Features a private yacht jetty, expansive infinity-edge pool, private cinema room, double-volume living area with floor-to-ceiling glass, Italian marble throughout, smart home automation, and 2-room staff quarters.

properties.title: The Grand Manor — Ultra-Modern Detached Duplex
properties.description: Sophisticated 5-bedroom contemporary detached duplex crafted with natural white limestone and custom bronze architectural louvers. Boasts a private manicured garden, Olympic-grade private lap pool, designer elevator, automated entrance gates, and solar hybrid backup power.

properties.title: Skyline Presidential Penthouse with Private Terrace
properties.address: High-Rise Tower, Aguiyi Ironsi Way, Maitama, Abuja
properties.description: A rare top-floor duplex penthouse in diplomatic Maitama with 360-degree panoramic views of the Abuja skyline and Aso Rock. Features an open-air entertainment terrace with fire pit and dining pergola, biometric elevator entry, private wine cellar, and 4 dedicated basement car parks.

properties.title: The Aurelia Contemporary Terrace Duplex
properties.address: Admiralty Way Axis, Lekki Phase 1, Lagos
properties.description: Stunning 4-bedroom terrace duplex in a secure, serene private cul-de-sac. Features multi-level terrace balconies, sleek warm ambient architectural illumination, premium German sanitary fittings, open-plan island kitchen, and built-in acoustic ceilings.

properties.title: The Glass Pavilion Luxury Mansion
properties.address: Kofo Abayomi Street, Victoria Island, Lagos
properties.description: An iconic modern residence combining commercial-grade structural steel and floor-to-ceiling glass pavilions. Features heated infinity pool, private wellness studio, manicured tropical courtyard, chef-grade preparation kitchen, and automated shade louvers.

about_content.who_we_are: SkyHome is a premier Nigerian luxury real estate advisory and property brokerage founded to redefine how discerning individuals, families, and global investors acquire prime residential and commercial real estate in Nigeria. We specialize in high-value properties in Lagos (Ikoyi, Banana Island, Victoria Island, Lekki Phase 1) and Abuja (Maitama, Asokoro, Guzape).
about_content.mission: To provide transparent, secure, and stress-free real estate acquisition experiences backed by rigorous title verification and dedicated white-glove advisory.
about_content.vision: To be the most trusted luxury property brand in Nigeria, connecting clients to their dream homes while safeguarding generational wealth.
why_choose_us: 100% Verified Titles: Every property undergoes thorough legal and title verification before listing.
Prime Nigerian Locations: Exclusive access to off-market and prime properties in Ikoyi, Banana Island, Lekki, and Maitama.
Transparent Process: No hidden charges, direct vendor communication, and end-to-end documentation handling.
Dedicated Advisory: Expert real estate consultants ready to guide your purchase via WhatsApp or private viewing.
about_content.customer_support: Our dedicated advisory team is available Monday through Saturday, 8:00 AM – 7:00 PM (WAT) to arrange physical property inspections, provide title documents, and answer purchase enquiries.
